title: Speak with an adviser by video
intro: A video appointment is a planned conversation with a Harbor Help adviser. You can use a phone, tablet or computer.
fact_title: What is the same for everyone
fact_body: A video appointment is not recorded. Harbor Help cannot open files or look inside your device.
privacy_body: We will not ask for your password or bank details. A support person can explain each step before the appointment.
action: Call the support line if you would like help booking a video appointment.
support: The support line can help with booking and joining. It is not an emergency service.
